CHORUS_SPREAD_RANGE.doc: The chorus's right-leg phase offset, in TURNS of its one oscillator (§2, §3a; the native-FX catalogue's M32 Dimension row). The right leg's voice k reads the LFO at k/N + spread: 0 is both legs one phase (the stage without the field, bit for bit), 0.25 quadrature, 0.5 the Dimension's opposed sweep. A fraction of a cycle carries no engineering symbol, so the unit is ''.
